metadata.name: labkit
metadata.description: Launchpad kits and fee routing for Raydium LaunchLab

accounts.name: platform_config
docs: `AmmConfig` a Raydium pool must use.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays for the creator PDA's WSOL account the first time.

accounts.name: creator_token
docs: Created here so LaunchLab's `init_if_needed` never asks the creator PDA for rent.

accounts.name: crank_token
docs: Any WSOL account. The crank picks where its reward goes.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays for the kit's WSOL account the first time.

accounts.name: kit_quote
docs: Created here so LaunchLab's `init_if_needed` never asks the kit PDA for rent.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays for the kit's token account the first time.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays for the kit's token account the first time.

accounts.name: platform_config
docs: `AmmConfig` the pool must use.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Pays ORAO and is refunded from the pot.

accounts.name: draw
docs: Only a Draw launch has one, so it stands in for checking the kit.

accounts.name: crank
docs: Pays for the kit's WSOL account if a Raydium split comes before any platform claim.

accounts.name: crank_token
docs: Any WSOL account. The crank picks where its reward goes.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Pays for the position the first time.

accounts.name: stake_pool
docs: Only Stake and Draw launches have one, so it stands in for checking the kit.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The client creates it with the associated token program's idempotent create.

accounts.name: kit_quote
docs: The client creates it the same way if no fees have reached the kit yet.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize LabKit.

errors.name: CrankFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Crank fee is above the maximum.

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury cannot be the default public key.

errors.name: TreasuryMismatch
errors.msg: Treasury token account is not owned by the configured treasury.

errors.name: NotPendingAuthority
errors.msg: Only the pending authority can accept.

errors.name: NothingToSplit
errors.msg: There is nothing to split.

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow.

errors.name: InvalidBps
errors.msg: A share in bps is above 100%.

errors.name: BadPoolState
errors.msg: Pool state is not a LaunchLab pool for this mint.

errors.name: PoolCreatorMismatch
errors.msg: The LaunchLab pool's creator is not this launch's creator PDA.

errors.name: InvalidRecipient
errors.msg: Recipient cannot be the default public key.

errors.name: RecipientMismatch
errors.msg: Recipient token account is not owned by the launch recipient.

errors.name: PlatformMismatch
errors.msg: The pool is not on this launch's platform.

errors.name: PoolMismatch
errors.msg: Pool state does not belong to this launch.

errors.name: InvalidPlatform
errors.msg: Platform settings are out of range.

errors.name: InvalidKit
errors.msg: Unknown or unavailable kit, or kit settings out of range.

errors.name: NotRegistered
errors.msg: The launch has no LaunchLab pool yet.

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.msg: The launch is already registered.

errors.name: QuoteNotSol
errors.msg: LabKit launches trade against SOL.

errors.name: WrongKit
errors.msg: This kit does not do that.

errors.name: CurveNotTrading
errors.msg: The bonding curve is not trading.

errors.name: NotMigrated
errors.msg: The launch has not moved to Raydium.

errors.name: NotGraduated
errors.msg: The curve has not completed yet.

errors.name: BelowMinimum
errors.msg: The kit's balance is under the minimum buy.

errors.name: AboveFloor
errors.msg: The price is above the floor line.

errors.name: BadAmmPool
errors.msg: The CPMM pool does not belong to this launch.

errors.name: Overspend
errors.msg: The buy spent more than planned.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: The amount must be above zero.

errors.name: InsufficientStake
errors.msg: That is more than is staked.

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: There are no rewards to claim.

errors.name: BadDrawTree
errors.msg: The draw tree does not match.

errors.name: DrawInProgress
errors.msg: A draw is in progress. Try again in a moment.

errors.name: NoDrawPending
errors.msg: No draw is waiting to be settled.

errors.name: DrawNotDue
errors.msg: The next draw is not due yet.

errors.name: PotTooSmall
errors.msg: The pot is under the minimum for a draw.

errors.name: NoStakers
errors.msg: Nobody is staked.

errors.name: DrawTooCostly
errors.msg: The VRF request cost more than a draw may refund.

errors.name: NotFulfilled
errors.msg: The randomness has not arrived yet.

errors.name: AlreadyFulfilled
errors.msg: The randomness has arrived, so the draw must be settled.

errors.name: NotTimedOut
errors.msg: The draw has not timed out yet.

errors.name: BadCandidate
errors.msg: A picked position is missing or wrong.

errors.name: ExecutedThisSlot
errors.msg: The kit already bought in this slot.

errors.name: UnsupportedBaseToken
errors.msg: LabKit launches use an SPL Token mint, not Token-2022.

errors.name: CreatorFeeNotQuote
errors.msg: Raydium creator fees must be taken in SOL only.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Set by `transfer_authority`, cleared by `accept_authority`. Default means none.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet whose token accounts receive the treasury share.

fields.name: fees
docs: Copied into each launch when it is created.

fields.name: platform
docs: The LaunchLab platform each new launch gets.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Claimed from LaunchLab in this instruction. Zero for a plain `split_creator_fees`.

fields.name: kit_amount
docs: Nonzero only for Raydium creator fees, after graduation.

types.name: Draw
docs: A Draw launch's schedule. Its stakers are in the launch's `StakePool`, and their stakes
in the `DrawTree`, so a random point in the total stake finds its owner in O(log n).

fields.name: round
docs: Draws settled, won or rolled over.

fields.name: pending
docs: Set from the VRF request until it is settled or cancelled. Stakes are frozen meanwhile.

fields.name: seed
docs: The ORAO request seed of the pending or last draw.

fields.name: last_draw
docs: When the last draw was settled, or the pool opened.

fields.name: won
docs: Lamports won in all draws.

fields.name: cost
docs: Lamports the pot refunded the keeper for the VRF fee and rent.

fields.name: winner
docs: Default when every pick was ineligible and the pot rolled over.

types.name: DrawTree
docs: Header of the draw tree account. Fenwick entries follow it as little-endian `u64`s,
one per staker, and the account grows by one entry for each new staker.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Set while a draw waits for randomness.

fields.name: len
docs: Entries in the tree.

fields.name: crank_bps
docs: Keeper share of creator-side fees, in bps. The recipient gets the rest.

fields.name: kit_bps
docs: Kit share of platform-side fees, in bps. The treasury gets the rest.

fields.name: amm_creator_bps
docs: Share of Raydium creator fees that counts as creator-side after graduation, in
bps. The rest counts as platform-side.

types.name: FeesSplit
docs: Referral fees moved from the fee wallet to the treasury.

types.name: KitExecuted
docs: 0 is the bonding curve, 1 is Raydium CPMM.

types.name: KitFeesClaimed
docs: A launch's platform fees, claimed and split between its kit and the treasury.

types.name: Launch
docs: A launch whose LaunchLab `creator` is `[CREATOR_SEED, base_mint]` and whose platform
is its own, administered by `[PLATFORM_ADMIN_SEED, base_mint]`.

fields.name: kit
docs: Chosen at creation and never changed.

fields.name: registered
docs: Set once the LaunchLab pool exists on the launch's platform.

fields.name: drawdown_bps
docs: Floor only: how far under the high the price must fall before the kit buys.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fixed at creation so a config change never reprices an existing launch.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Receives the creator's share. Only this wallet can change it.

fields.name: high_q64
docs: Floor only: the highest price seen, in lamports per raw token, Q64.64. It starts at
the curve's opening price and rises no faster than `HIGH_RISE_BPS` allows.

fields.name: high_at
docs: Floor only: when `high_q64` last rose, in Unix seconds.

fields.name: kit_funded
docs: Lamports routed to the kit.

fields.name: spent
docs: Lamports the kit spent on buys.

fields.name: burned
docs: Raw tokens the kit bought and burned.

fields.name: released
docs: Graduate only: lamports paid to the recipient after the curve completed.

fields.name: drawdown_bps
docs: Floor only, zero otherwise.

fields.name: fee_rate
docs: Platform fee on every curve trade, on LaunchLab's 1_000_000 denominator.

fields.name: creator_fee_rate
docs: Creator fee on every curve trade, on LaunchLab's 1_000_000 denominator.

fields.name: lp_lock_scale
docs: Share of graduated liquidity locked to `nft_wallet`, on LaunchLab's denominator.
The rest is burned.

fields.name: cpswap_config
docs: The CPMM `AmmConfig` launches graduate into. Its creator fee applies after graduation.

types.name: StakePool
docs: A Stake launch's pool. Its token account `ATA(base_mint, pool)` holds the staked
tokens. Rewards stay in the kit's WSOL account until claimed.

fields.name: total_staked
docs: Raw tokens staked.

fields.name: reward_per_token_q64
docs: Lamports streamed per staked raw token since the pool opened, Q64.64.

fields.name: streaming
docs: Lamports received and not yet streamed.

fields.name: stream_end
docs: When `streaming` is fully paid out, in Unix seconds.

fields.name: distributed
docs: Lamports streamed to stakers.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Lamports stakers have claimed.

types.name: StakePosition
docs: One wallet's stake in a launch.

fields.name: amount
docs: Raw tokens staked.

fields.name: reward_per_token_q64
docs: The pool's `reward_per_token_q64` when `earned` was last brought up to date.

fields.name: earned
docs: Lamports earned and not yet claimed. Draw: prizes won.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Lamports claimed.

fields.name: slot
docs: Draw only: the position's 1-based index in the draw tree, zero until the first stake.

fields.name: staked_at
docs: When the stake last grew, in Unix seconds.

fields.name: position
docs: The owner's stake afterwards.

fields.name: position
docs: The owner's stake afterwards.
